name: Baker Street Vice Lords
description: The Baker Street Vice Lords were started in Lansing, Michigan by two Chicago Vice Lords named Eight-Ball and Ice. Eight-Ball moved to Lansing and lived with his aunt on Baker Street on the city's South Side, where he recruited local teens into his own section of the Vice Lords. The gang was made up of mostly white and Black members and became known as the largest and toughest gang in Lansing. They were allied with the North Side Crips, a mainly Latino gang that controlled Lansing's North Side. The Baker Street Vice Lords were active from the late 1980s through the 1990s, eventually spreading to Jackson, Flint, and Detroit before disbanding after leadership received lengthy prison sentences.
